hints.title: Partitioned Grade Ranking with Course Tie-Breaker
hints.text: Identify the top grade for each student, selecting the smaller course identifier in case of grade ties.

hints.title: Row Number Window Ordering
hints.text: Assign row numbers partitioned by student identifier, ordered descending by grade and ascending by course identifier.

hints.title: Highest Grade Query Blueprint
hints.text: with Ranked as (select student_id, course_id, grade, row_number() over (partition by student_id order by grade desc, course_id asc) as rn from Enrollments) select student_id, course_id, grade from Ranked where rn = 1 order by student_id asc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT student_id, course_id, grade,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY student_id
               ORDER BY grade DESC, course_id ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM Enrollments
)
SELECT student_id, course_id, grade
FROM Ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY student_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Window sorting partitioned by student executes in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Group by with max grade fails to isolate the corresponding course identifier deterministically in standard SQL.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Window ranking computes ranks in a single pass without re-joining the base table on composite keys.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of ROW_NUMBER() with secondary ordering by course_id to resolve ties.
